payload.message: Runtime defect observed while recording handoff_855fdfcc38b77e86132342f1fd: 'pulse work handoff --evidence-receipt <id>' fails with lock_timeout after 10s even though the workgraph flock is free (verified with an independent non-blocking flock probe). Handoff without --evidence-receipt succeeds immediately. Likely re-entrant WriteGuard acquisition: the handoff holds the write lock and the receipt lookup for --evidence-receipt acquires it again. Handoff recorded without receipt ids; candidate receipts are named in the handoff summary.
